The petitioners filed these petitions U/Sec.166 of the
Motor Vehicles Act claiming compensation for the injuries
sustained by them in the road traffic accident that
occurred on 03.06.2023.
The petition averments in brief are as under:

On 03.06.2023 at about 6.30 p.m., the petitioner in MVC No.4155/2023 was proceeding as a rider in a motor cycle bearing No.KA.05.LK.4257 along with his friend i.e.,
the petitioner in MVC No.4156/2023 as a pillion rider on the extreme left side of the road near Akasha Vani circle opp to Bharath Petrol bunk, KRS road, Mysore, at that time, a Car bearing No.KA-09-ME-2221 came with high speed, in a rash and negligent manner, endangering human life and dashed against the petitioners'
motorcycle.
Due to the impact, both the petitioners fell down and sustained grievous injuries.

It is relevant to note that, Clavicle bone means (collarbone) is a long, slightly curved bone that connects your arm to your body.
The said bone can be found one on both sides of the base of the neck.
The bones helps to keep a shoulder blade in the correct position as a person move.
The word "clavicle" comes from the Latin "clavicula," which translates to "little key."
The bone is actually shaped a bit like an old-fashioned key and it works in much the same way.
When one rotate a key, it moves the lock.
Similarly, when a person lift a arm, a clavicle rotates along its axis to allow movement.

18 clavicle, or collarbone, is a slender, S-shaped long bone approximately 6 inches (15 cm) long that serves as a  SCCH- 17 26 MVC No.4155/2023  & 4156/2023 strut between the shoulder blade and the sternum (breastbone).There are two clavicles, one on the left and one on the right.
The clavicle is the only long bone in the body that lies horizontally.
Together with the shoulder blade, it makes up the shoulder girdle.
It is a palpable bone and, in people who have less fat in this region, the location of the bone is clearly visible.
It receives its name from Latin clavicula 'little key' because the bone rotates along its axis like a key when the shoulder is abducted.
The clavicle is the most commonly fractured bone.
It can easily be fractured by impacts to the shoulder from the force of falling on outstretched arms or by a direct hit.
It is relevant to note that, Clavicle or collar bone is as lender S shaped bone approximately 6 inches that serves as as truth between the shoulder blade and the sternum.
Together with the shoulder blade, it makes up the shoulder griddle.
To put it differently, clavicle bone is not a separate component of the arm but just a  SCCH- 17 27 MVC No.4155/2023  & 4156/2023 supporting bone.
It is in this view of the matter, no disability is prescribed for clavicle fracture in the Government of India guidelines 2018.

sentences.text: The records clearly disclose that due  to the actionable negligence on the part of  the rider of the scooter, the claimant fell  down and sustained fracture of clavicle  bone on 19-03-2009.
He has taken  treatment in the District Hospital, Mandya.
He was treated conservatively and he has  not undergone any surgery, he has  submitted the medical bill for Rs.6,000/-.
The doctor who issued the disability  certificate is not the treated doctor.
For the  fracture of clavicle bone, the doctor has  assessed the disability to an extent of  20% which is contrary to law.
The  clavicle bone is only an ornamental bone  and the said fracture does not lead to any  disability.
In the instant case, the  disability assessed by the doctor is  contrary to law.
The Tribunal taking into  consideration the injuries sustained and  SCCH- 17 28 MVC No.4155/2023  & 4156/2023  suffering undergone awarded just and fair  compensation.
The appellant has not made  out a case to interfere with the said  judgment and award.
Accordingly, the  appeal is dismissed.
In the present case also the petitioner sustained only clavicle injury and no neuro vascular deficits.
As per the evidence of PW.4 doctor the fracture is united as such, there is no disability is caused to the avocation of the petitioner.
